verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs describe a versioned REST API (v4) that follows semantic versioning, plus a dedicated REST API deprecations page listing changes users should review and adopt. Breaking changes are explicitly kept out of v4, and an autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec helps keep the API contract accurate. Missing for 10: details of the deprecation policy itself (notice periods, removal timelines), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: GitLab will not make these changes within REST API v4, and follows semantic versioning for the REST API
You should regularly review the following deprecations and make the recommended changes
The OpenAPI spec is autogenerated directly from the API code and is tightly coupled to its implementation, ensuring the documentation is always accurate and up to date
